mapper.select: SELECT id AS bookmark_id, users_id, merchants_id, created_at, updated_at FROM bookmarks WHERE id = #{bookmarkId} AND is_deleted IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE bookmarks SET is_deleted = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{bookmarkId} AND is_deleted IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS bookmark_id, b.merchants_id, b.created_at, m.category, m.name, m.thumbnail_url, m.address, m.price, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN COALESCE(m.rating, 0.0) ELSE 0.0 END AS rating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r WHERE r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE') AS review_count FROM bookmarks b JOIN merchants m ON m.id = b.merchants_id WHERE b.id = #{bookmarkId} AND b.is_deleted IS NULL
